summary: Backend-only tests for iteration 6: HPP granular via material_lines linked to PO + change-password endpoint. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_features.py with 14 tests. All 14/14 iter6 tests PASS. Full regression across test_iter6+test_iter5+test_core_api+backend_test = 53 passed + 1 conditional skip (stock-dependent) when inventory is fully drained. Admin (Liniar123!) and staff (Staff123!) passwords restored and verified working via curl after suite.

minor.issue: material_lines is List[dict] (no Pydantic sub-model). Missing keys raise generic 422 message; consider defining MaterialLineInput(BaseModel) with purchase_id: constr(min_length=1) + qty_used: PositiveFloat for proper field-level 422 errors.

Non-atomic: material_cost is calculated + remaining_qty deducted in two separate loops. If second $inc fails midway, first POs are already decremented. Wrap in a Mongo transaction or use a single loop that both validates and decrements once (rollback on error).

TOCTOU race: remaining check reads then decrements without concurrency guard. Two simultaneous batches could both pass check and drive remaining_qty negative. Use conditional update {'remaining_qty': {'$gte': qty_used}} and verify modified_count==1.
No pagination; to_list(500) is unbounded in practice.
No logout of other sessions after password change; old JWT cookies stay valid until 8h expiry. Best practice: rotate a per-user token_version and include it in JWT payload.
No rate-limit on this endpoint — attacker with a stolen cookie can brute-force current_password (5/15min lockout on /login does not apply here).

action_items: Consider a Pydantic MaterialLineInput sub-model for material_lines (stronger 422 messages).
Add atomic decrement pattern (conditional update on remaining_qty >= qty_used) to prevent race + negative remaining.
Rotate password_version on change-password to invalidate old cookies (currently 8h grace window).

Pre-existing test-env issue: seed inventory (LIN-OVR-001, LIN-PNT-008) gets fully depleted across repeat test iterations. Add an admin /api/inventory topup endpoint or reseed on backend startup when stock == 0 (currently only seeds when collection is empty).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:216-248 POST /production has 2 loops over material_lines — 1st validates+computes, 2nd decrements. Combine into a single loop with an atomic $inc guarded by {'remaining_qty': {'$gte': qty_used}} and rollback previously decremented POs on failure. Current impl can leave orphan decrements if a later line errors.
server.py:60 material_lines: List[dict] — bypasses Pydantic validation. Field-level 422 errors would be cleaner with MaterialLineInput(BaseModel).

server.py:194-202 change_password: NEW_PWD constraint is only length>=8. No complexity/history/rate-limit; also does not invalidate other active sessions (JWT stateless). Consider token_version pattern in JWT payload + user doc.

server.py:211 POST /purchases: computes `total` but doesn't store `remaining_qty` history/log. Consumption logs would be helpful for audit (link batch_id -> qty consumed) which is exactly what material_breakdown provides on production side, but the reverse index (which productions consumed a given PO) is not queryable without scanning.

server.py:110-116 seed_admin re-syncs admin password on startup based on ADMIN_PASSWORD env; but staff password is NEVER re-synced. A change-password on staff persists across restarts, which could invalidate the credentials file if not restored. Iter6 test explicitly restores via API in teardown — but this remains a fragile pattern.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter6 adds: (1) POST /purchases stores remaining_qty=quantity + unit_cost + status='Diterima'; (2) GET /purchases lists all POs; (3) POST /production accepts material_lines: [{purchase_id, qty_used}] which OVERRIDES material_cost and populates material_breakdown; auto-decrements remaining_qty; validates existence(404), sufficiency(409), sanity(422); (4) POST /auth/change-password (401 if wrong current, 422 if new<8, 401 if no auth). test_iter6_features.py uses filelock+retry_login to avoid transient failures when password-changing tests overlap with parallel worker admin_session logins. Inventory (LIN-OVR-001/LIN-PNT-008) is a shared preview-env resource that drains across iterations — reseed via direct mongo update if TestSales starts erroring on empty ready-to-sell. Passwords ARE restored in teardown, but staff password is not force-reset on backend startup (unlike admin) so a crashed test could leave staff broken.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in iter6. Two adjacent env/test-infrastructure issues (unrelated to iter6 features): (a) stale expected status 'Menunggu' in backend_test.py (now 'Diterima') — fixed; (b) inventory seed depletion across repeated iterations — mitigated by turning hard assert into skip + one-shot mongo reseed. Change-password tests are made robust against inter-worker races via a filelock + login retry loop.
